note: Kentucky State Parks campground in the Pennyrile Forest near Dawson Springs, back-in sites on short spurs off wooded loops, set back from the park's small lake and its beach. Eight pull-through equestrian sites with hitching posts sit by the horse trails and are booked by phone. Lodge, restaurant, golf course and boat rentals in the park. --Claude
summary: Kept. 63 sites (25 full hookup, 10 water/electric, 8 equestrian, primitive), 20/30/50A, one 90-ft pull-through. Fees 30-45 by type and night (stored 30-40). Season 2027 Apr 1 - Nov 15 for standard sites (RA online from Apr 2), equestrian year-round. Not waterfront (lake ~500 m).
